title: Frosts - A data science framework for Microsoft Office Scripts
prefeaturesdescription: Frosts is a reusable Office Scripts framework that allows pandas-like data manipulation for Excel macros and Office Script API requests.
features: Familiar, chainable syntax inspired by Python's pandas
Built-in utilities for grouping, merging, filtering, and more
Effortless Integration into Power Automate pipelines JSON, CSV, and XLSX I/O
postfeaturesdescription: Built to simplify and standardize advanced Excel scripting for analysts, low-code developers, and help bridge the gap from Excel automation to the world of data science.
